title: ardisia zeylanica
intro: Ardisia zeylanica, commonly known as "Red Chasterberry" or "Paliya", is a species of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Ardisia zeylanica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are thought to be caused by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and bioactive constituents.
